name: goose-skills
description: GooseWorks skill catalog: marketing playbooks, video skills and the entry skills the gooseworks CLI installs. Not published to npm; install with npx gooseworks@latest install --with <slug>.

scripts.test: node --test test/*.test.js scripts/__tests__/*.test.js scripts/__tests__/*.test.mjs && node scripts/run-skill-node-tests.js
scripts.ci: node scripts/validate-skills.js && node scripts/build-index.js && git diff --exit-code skills-index.json && node scripts/check-skill-links.js && node scripts/check-tool-names.js && node scripts/check-internal-ids.js && node scripts/check-client-names.js && node scripts/build-router.js --check && node scripts/check-lfs-pointers.js && npm test && python3 skills/video/write-video-ad-script/scripts/verify_handoff.py && python3 skills/video/review-ugc-render/tests/test_review_render.py && python3 skills/video/render-street-interview/scripts/selftest.py && python3 -m unittest discover -s skills/video/render-street-interview/tests -p test_prompt_budget.py && python3 skills/marketing/improve-search-visibility/tests/run-fixtures.py
